create_AccuracyAtK: create an AccuracyAtK metric to evaluate the maximum accuracy among the first k predictions
test_AccuracyAtK: test AccuracyAtK with a target answer and a sequence of predicted answers with confidence scores
run_AccuracyAtK: run AccuracyAtK to compute accuracy at k for self-consistency strategy evaluation
refactor_AccuracyAtK: refactor AccuracyAtK to use a custom base metric instead of default exact-match accuracy
review_AccuracyAtK: review AccuracyAtK to return the maximum accuracy value from the first k candidate predictions
